The benefit of Section 428 CrPC has also been provided to the appellant.

sentences.text: When the victim was taken for medical examination where for the first time she introduced the name of the present appellant as the one who had committed the crime in March, 2018.
She further submits that even the FSL Report collected during the investigation connects only JCL and not the appellant.
Lastly, it is stated that the appellant has undergone almost 8 years and 6 months by now out of the maximum sentence of 10 years awarded under Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

She places reliance on the decisions in Saudan Singh vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh, reported as 2021 SCC OnLine SC 3259, and Sonadhar vs. The State of Chhattisgarh, reported as 2021 SCC OnLine SC 3182.
